scope: Offline synthetic crash-ownership and cleanup controls only; no actual Simulator, app or native acceptance execution

checks.name: two-object IPS accepts exact owned phase, including pre-PID launch failure binding
reject foreign PID/device/bundle/name/path, old/future report times, old/future file times, conflicting bundle and naive timestamp
text crash format has same owned PID/path/bundle/time checks
collector copies only owned newly created report; leaves other reports, sources and symlink untouched
unrelated transient encoding error cannot block delayed owned report; final scan preserves captured stack after source rotation and frozen observation end
candidate disappearance records only category and continues to readable owned report
early launch error still collects report without PID before controlled termination and retains phase receipt
stuck owned console launcher receives bounded TERM/KILL cleanup and retains phase evidence
normal diagnostic remains nonacceptance and collects before deleting only owned simulator
shutdown timeout still attempts delete and verifies membership
delete failure remains a failure and membership does not claim cleanup
phase exception still collects bounded logs and independently cleans owned simulator
strict restoration functions and existing workflow jobs identical; diagnostic returns before cloud/UI/composer and cannot publish acceptance
